metadata.title: CitrixMoveUsers
metadata.description:
This is an adminstrative tool for Citrix Virtual Apps and Dekstops
This Powershell script will allow for the move of a Virtual Desktop connection into a new 
machine catalog and desktop group and assign a User and City Tag if specified. 
Edit variables to fit your Citrix Cloud environment.
Run powershell as admin, then run this file with command: powershell .\Citrix-Add-Move-Users.ps1
For reference see developer-docs.citrix.com/projects/citrix-virtual-apps-desktops/
You also need the Citrix Virtual Desktop and Apps SDK installed. Download from site link below
citrix.com/downloads/citrix-cloud/product-software/xenapp-and-desktop-service.html and select
Virtual Apps and Desktops Remote Powershell SDK

SET machine name "Domain\Machinename"
